notes.title: Summer update is approaching - let's check out what's on the table~
notes.notes:
Hey there, friends!

Are you ready for the summer mini stories load? We hope you are, because we've been cooking✨

Let's check out a couple stories in the making!

All the girls are going on a vacation with their partners and are ready to show off their interests! Have you ever seen a nurse fix a motorbike? Well, you're about to, because Kira is a skilled girlie in multiple fields.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/10d1877944a9f454b1690db0f4114caa3424af6d.jpg[/img]
 
Fred surely got himself a girl of his dreams. Looking forward to them driving through the whole country and fuck in every motel and gas station!

Now, our rock band hasn't been wasting time, too. Not only they've gathered together to touch some grass, but reportedly they have been barbequing and placing inapropriate bets on one another!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/e169728b50ad312433e6b8a73cf384d38cab09ee.jpg[/img]

Can you tell who's the target of the bets? Of course, our young and loud couple. So much for hiding from your bandmates, huh?

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/14a7ab491880cedc1db105aff94e16816bebebe5.jpg[/img]

What can we say? Fresh air inclines to romance and gambling!

Which story are you waiting for the most? Tell us in the comments!

notes.title: Halloween update is here!
notes.notes:
Hey there friends!

It’s Spooky Season again! Let’s have as much fun as possible with the Halloween update!
The girls and their partners are back with a set of mini stories complete with bonus artworks. 

Become a detective and infiltrate the mafia, help with shooting a pin-up calendar, find out how nurse uniforms can become even sexier, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/bc48263eababb8ee80a735ddc7134990ea07c3a4.png[/img]

It’s time for you to choose a costume for your roommates' party, and you better find a really cool one for the girls to enjoy. Or, choose a trip to the 2000s together with a rock band with a spicy twist!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43296917/c76ab254976de6b42a9ce5859e926a01afe239ef.png[/img]

Paired with match-3, it's a short but festive adventure coming from us straight to your PCs with loads of love.

Thank you for always supporting us on various platforms, having fun conversations and making more games come to life. We also remember that community items are still on us, but sometimes the process takes longer than expected, so let’s forgive our big boss Drakonika and let her cook a little bit longer. Promise the items will be awesome, and loads of them!

Our friends' game is soon to be released, so if you like battles and women, check out [b]Sexy Iron Maidens[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2686320/Sexy_Iron_Maidens/

And don't miss out on our next project - [b]Dungeons and Furries[/b]
